GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Straight Out The Back Settled Down Off Mid-Field Inside 6 Lengths Saved Ground Turning for home Soon After off the Inside Ridden Along , kept trying without threatening - # not quick enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the home straight. Between the 100m and 50m was impeded when attempting to improve into a tight run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along ! but outpaced Settled Down 7th Inside 5 Lengths 6th @ 600m 4 Lengths asked to go at the 400m railed Kept Finding Kept Coming , in Lead x 50m, # too good!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Approaching the 50m became unbalanced when bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down well back 3 Wide with a trail 7 Lengths Not Enough Pace On to assist, Ridden Along Turning for home held-up @ 350m Kept Coming Closest was not run to suit - # went good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On straightening was disappointed for a run. When closing the race off, was required to alter course to the inside of another runner after passing the 100m to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Ridden Along ! Settled Down 10th Inside 7 Lengths Good Pace on, trav well! within 6 Lengths Straightening Up not clrst path until 300m, 4th x 100m Took over x 50m, (bar plates off) # nice return
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m was steadied when placed in restricted room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 5th 1x1 3 Lengths then 4 Lengths x 800m asked to go at the 400m couldn't quicken couldn't finish off (bar plates 1st time) # bar plates lame 3/5
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Over the final 50m was awkwardly placed. Rdr reported his mnt was able to obtain a good position behind the leading runners, however it did not travel comfortably due to the strong tempo, and in his opinion, the mare would be better suited when ridden more conservatively over a shorter distance. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to be lame (3/5) in the near foreleg. Tnr was advised a vet clearance is required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Ridden Along Settled Down 7th 5 Lengths Hooked Out 3 Wide with a trail x 700m, quickened from 300m Took over x 50m, # simply too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To settle further forward; settled midfield.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Ridden Along but Straight Out The Back 7 Lengths off leader/winner Not Enough Pace On to assist, asked to go Straightening Up but had an imposs task, Kept Finding Closest on line, Winner Led All The Way 1st 2 out 1st 2 home - this was # very good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Straight Out The Back Settled Down rear 8 Lengths off leader/winner within 7 Lengths x Turn , held-up to 100m kept on to the line (b/off v/1st) - not surprisingly stewards had quite the chat with rider - # a complete forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re riding, rdr std from wide barrier she was instructed to ride where comfortable, anticipating this would be back in the field. Std after settling at rear she initially considered improving to the extreme outside on entering the straight, however bearing in mind the strong headwind, she elected to pursue runs closer to the inside. Std on straightening she identified a favoured runner to follow, but when that horse did not initially quicken as expected, she improved to be racing inside its heels & became badly held up & was unable to shift out until near the 50m.
